description.value: A consignment and new sporting goods store in Cranbrook operating since 2002, specializing in affordable new and used outdoor gear. Bicycles are among the equipment they sell and repair, making them a useful stop for touring cyclists needing mechanical help in the East Kootenays.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Funhogz is a consignment and new sporting goods store in Cranbrook that sells bicycles among many other sports equipment and offers bike repair services. The repairs page states 'If it can be repaired, we will repair it... Bring it in and let us take a look,' supporting walk-in repairs and staff help with mechanicals. OSM tags confirm shop=bicycle. No specific mention of pump access, touring parts, rentals, or any other cycling-specific amenities beyond sales and repair.
